notes: One clear source: 4speedconversions 1962 Chevy clutch linkage list (search snippet; site 403). Tracyvette lists 3748358 as 1968-81 Corvette clutch pedal rod washer (matches AIM 7/C2). A transmission fastener kit seller calls it a P washer. 21/64 is the stated size (likely ID); OD/thickness unknown.
